does: An output style with a status block around each step, short plain replies, linked references and big jobs handed to agents. Cursor gets it as start text.

children.does: Shows what is done, what is next, what was assumed and what the user must decide, before and after each step.
Keeps each reply short enough to read in 30 seconds.
Says in one line what each step does and where, with full paths.
Asks for short sentences and common words.
Links every PR, issue, ticket, doc and file each time a reply names it.
Keeps quick checks in the main chat and hands larger jobs to agents.
